form:FormGroup.label: Max Store Size
form:FormGroup.helpText: How big this store's data file may grow. Writes fail once it is full, so leave some headroom.

form:FormGroup.label: Synchronise Data Merges On Write
form:FormGroup.helpText: When writing data, should processors wait until data is fully merged into Plan B shards before marking stream processing as complete.

form:FormGroup.label: Overwrite Existing Data
form:FormGroup.helpText: If subsequent data that is loaded matches an existing key then should the existing be kept or overwritten? By default Plan B will overwrite existing data.
